sql.where:
isDel = 0 and role = 2 and idx <> 174
and ${param.searchField} like '%${param.searchWord}%'

mapper.select:
SELECT idx, groupName, deviceAmount, franchAmount, cprtCompanyAmount, spareDeviceAmount, isDel, createDate, lastModifiedDate, concat(cprtCompanyAmount, deviceAmount, franchAmount) AS fieldSort, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, createDate, now()) AS timdDiff, (CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, createDate, now()) < 5 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) as newContent FROM (SELECT g.idx AS idx, g.groupName AS groupName, IFNULL(dev.cnt, 0) AS deviceAmount, IFNULL(fr.cnt, 0) AS franchAmount, IFNULL(cpr.cnt, 0) AS cprtCompanyAmount, IFNULL(sp.cnt, 0) AS spareDeviceAmount, g.isDel AS isDel, g.createDate AS createDate, g.lastModifiedDate AS lastModifiedDate FROM TB_GROUP g LEFT JOIN (SELECT A.groupIdx AS groupIdx, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM TB_CONSTRUCTION A JOIN TB_DEVICE B ON A.ID = B.constructionIdx WHERE A.isDel = 0 AND A.conduct = 0 AND B.isDel = 0 AND B.conduct = 0 GROUP BY A.groupIdx) dev ON dev.groupIdx = g.idx LEFT JOIN (SELECT A.groupIdx AS groupIdx, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM TB_CONSTRUCTION A JOIN TB_DEVICE B ON A.ID = B.constructionIdx WHERE A.isDel = 0 AND A.conduct = 0 AND B.isDel = 0 AND B.conduct = 2 GROUP BY A.groupIdx) fr ON fr.groupIdx = g.idx LEFT JOIN (SELECT A.groupIdx AS groupIdx, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM TB_CONSTRUCTION A WHERE A.conduct = 0 AND A.isDel = 0 GROUP BY A.groupIdx) cpr ON cpr.groupIdx = g.idx LEFT JOIN (SELECT TC.groupIdx AS groupIdx, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM TB_SPARE_DEVICE TSD JOIN TB_CONSTRUCTION TC ON TC.id = TSD.constructionIdx WHERE TC.conduct = 0 AND TC.isDel = 0 AND TSD.type = 0 AND TSD.status = 0 GROUP BY TC.groupIdx) sp ON sp.groupIdx = g.idx
) NN ORDER BY CASE WHEN timdDiff < 5 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END asc , FIELD(idx, 161, 10000, idx) ASC , FIELD(fieldSort, '000') ASC, idx DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{startRow}
